description: Target platform party-role entity: one row per client holding a role on a policy, carrying the policy and product attributes needed to service that role.

attributes.name: role_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the role record.

attributes.name: policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference of the policy the role belongs to.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the party (person, organisation, adviser or branch) holding the role.

attributes.name: client_role
attributes.description: The role the client plays on the policy.

attributes.name: client_category
attributes.description: Category of the client record.

attributes.name: role_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the role record.

attributes.name: joint_life_sequence
attributes.description: Position of the client within the role: 0 single, 1 first, 2 second.

attributes.name: surname_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short surname of the first life, used for alphabetical listing. Stored in uppercase with no leading or trailing spaces.

attributes.name: role_start_date
attributes.description: Date the client started in the role.

attributes.name: role_end_date
attributes.description: Date the client ceased to hold the role; null while the role is open.

attributes.name: has_unique_address
attributes.description: True when the party uses a correspondence address unique to this policy.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Product the policy was sold under.

attributes.name: product_version_number
attributes.description: Version of the product terms.

attributes.name: is_group_policy
attributes.description: True when the policy belongs to a group (employer-sponsored) arrangement, false otherwise.

attributes.name: policy_start_date
attributes.description: Date the policy commenced (came into force).

attributes.name: paid_up_date
attributes.description: Date the policy was made paid up; null if it has never been paid up.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Current maturity date of the policy; null for products with no maturity.

attributes.name: original_maturity_date
attributes.description: Maturity date originally agreed at inception, used for projections.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy.

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason the policy exited; null while the policy is active.

attributes.name: tax_qualifying_status
attributes.description: Whether the policy qualifies for tax relief on the benefit.

attributes.name: conditions_book_code
attributes.description: Code of the policy conditions booklet issued with the policy.

attributes.name: service_office_code
attributes.description: Code of the office responsible for servicing the policy.

attributes.name: premium_contribution
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount in GBP contributed by the party holding this role; null for roles that do not pay premiums.

attributes.name: policy_active_role_count
attributes.description: Number of active role records held on the policy as a whole (all clients, all roles). Policy-level figure, repeated on every role row of the policy.

attributes.name: policy_beneficiary_count
attributes.description: Number of active beneficiaries nominated on the policy. Policy-level figure, repeated on every role row of the policy; 0 when no beneficiary is nominated.

attributes.name: policy_beneficiary_share_total
attributes.description: Total of the benefit share percentages across all active beneficiaries of the policy. Policy-level figure, repeated on every role row; null when the policy has no beneficiary.

attributes.name: policy_total_monthly_premium
attributes.description: Total monthly premium in GBP received on the policy, summed over every active role that contributes. Policy-level figure, repeated on every role row (not only the paying role); null for single-premium policies.
